sources.excerpt: Swindle — Union Tube Transistor Welcome Shop Dealers Buzz Contact Welcome Shop Dealers Buzz Contact Union Tube Transistor is based in East Vancouver, BC Canada. We strive for best practices in our building of musical equipment, pursuing ease of use in durable, repairable products. Our pursuit of great tone is its own reward. ← Back to Shop Swindle Swindle from $190.00 Overdrive not enough but fuzz is too much? The Swindle may help you find your sweet spot. This is a versatile distortion on the line between drive and fuzz that brings rich saturation to any signal. A perfect tool for those looking for a bit more break-up than overdrive alone but without the chord-flattening funk of a proper fuzz, Swindle rides a delicate balance between two worlds with ample range to explore diverse tones. Controls for gain and volume allow you to set tone and output level independently, ensuring the volume doesn't jump aggressively when engaging the pedal. If you're looking to bring back the 70s UK punk sound or create your own sound this is the pedal that will do it. Draw is 12mA. Deluxe version has a wooden box, bandana, and laser engraved badge. Bean Counter version has a silkscreened graphic made to look like the badge, and no special packaging.
